value_hash.chunking: payload_to_field_chunks: chunk[0]=(0x10<<64)|len LE-packed; then up to 3 31-byte LE payload groups (final right-zero-padded, top byte 0); missing chunks zero-padded to exactly 4 inputs
value_hash.construction: bounded arity-4 Poseidon over [length_element, chunk0, chunk1, chunk2] with the 'sponge' instance (capacity-init 0x12)
value_hash.empty_sentinel: value_hash=0 (field zero); populated cell with value_hash==0 fails closed ERR_VALUE_HASH_ZERO
